instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a cozy indoor living room. On a yellow couch, the person with short curly hair and glasses (R1) sits on the right, looking attentively at R2 while holding a pen near a document. On the left, the person with short dark hair in the green sweatshirt (R2) looks down at the document in their hands, speaking. They sit side-by-side, reviewing the paper over a wooden coffee table in the foreground holding a laptop and a cup of black coffee. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene with natural tones.
